lines.1: 「Whew, that's another day of classes done and dusted.」
lines.2: 「Mr. Tsushima, please come to the faculty room after school.」
lines.4: 「When a teacher gives you an order, the answer's always yes, boy.」
lines.6: The classroom broke into a buzz.
lines.7: Hmm. What did I do this time?
lines.9: 「Mr. Tsushima, do you have any idea why you've been called in?」
lines.11: 「You've got the brains of a bird, kid.」
lines.13: 「Then I'll get straight to the point. You and Miss Kurogane have been ordered to report to the director's office tomorrow.」
lines.15: 「A young couple under one roof... You can see how that might raise questions, can't you, boy?」
lines.17: Damn. Word had gotten all the way here.
lines.19: 「You would be wise not to volunteer anything unnecessary, Mr. Tsushima.」
lines.21: 「Use the time until tomorrow to prepare your case properly.」
lines.22: 「Giving you that time is my own little act of kindness.」
lines.23: 「If you don't find yourself a solid way out...」
lines.24: 「you may not be allowed to keep living with Otome.」
lines.27: 「I might not be able to keep living with Otome...」
lines.29: I had to find some way through this.
lines.31: 「Otome, I've had a hard time figuring out how to bring this up...」
lines.32: 「You mean being summoned to the director's office tomorrow? Miss Oeyama told me today as well.」
lines.35: 「What do you think we should do?」
lines.37: 「You've been giving this some thought. What's the first?」
lines.38: 「We take a page from the people who keep this country running.」
lines.39: 「Want to try it? Ask me something, Otome.」
lines.40: 「I've heard the two of you are romantically involved. Is that true?」
lines.42: 「There are also reports that you were flirting in front of the school gates.」
lines.43: 「I recognize that something of the sort may have occurred, but only at a level warranting a caution. Our proximity was due to our relationship as older sister and younger brother.」
lines.44: 「Rumors are spreading among the students. What do you intend to do about that?」
lines.45: 「We intend to consider the matter positively and take appropriate action.」
lines.46: My ultimate grown-up strategy: never state the truth outright.
lines.47: 「...If you talk like that to the director, there's a one-hundred-percent chance he'll get mad.」
lines.49: 「Then my other idea is just telling him the truth.」
lines.53: 「I'd be pathetic if I left it all to you.」
